tldr: Venus through the 3rd house brings focus to communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement.
body: Venus transiting the 3rd house softens communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement. For about three to four weeks, ease, attraction, value, pleasure, and relational support move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a receiving transit: it can bring support, pleasure, repair, and opportunities to value this area with more grace.
business: Venus supports writing, messaging, and local connection: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Avoidance, indulgence, people-pleasing, or scattered attention or reactive speech.
advice: Receive and refine in the 3rd house deliberately. Work with communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
